$schema_note: Versioned, citable symptom-class to nutrient mapping for the NutriDeq NLP engine. Keywords are case-insensitive substring matchers applied to lowercased extracted symptom text. Classes are evaluated in array order; first match wins. nutrient_name values are exact fct_nutrients.nutrient_name keys (DOST-FNRI Food Composition Table).
citation: Symptom classes: NutriDeq clinical knowledge base (includes/ai_symptom_kb.php). Nutrient keys: DOST-FNRI Food Composition Table (fct_nutrients). Reference values: Philippine Dietary Reference Intakes 2015, FNRI-DOST (Revised Sept 2018).
language_note: Keywords cover English, Tagalog/Taglish, and verified Cebuano/Bisaya terms. Regional terms are added ONLY after linguistic verification (see dev-tools/EVAL_RUNBOOK.md, corpus governance): unverified candidates are deliberately excluded to protect annotation integrity — Ilocano terms are pending verification and are intentionally absent in this version.
changelog: 1.2.0 (2026-09-22): Added verified Cebuano/Bisaya terms (kapoy; sakit ug ulo). Fixed SC-BLOAT keyword error: 'hininga' (breath) corrected to 'hangin' (gas/wind, as in 'may hangin ang tiyan'). Stemmed 'exhausted' to 'exhaust' so exhaustion/exhausted both match. Documented the deliberate SC-CRAMP 'kabag sa kalamnan' vs SC-BLOAT 'kabag' precedence rule.
1.1.0 (2026-09-22): Initial versioned extraction from the hardcoded ai_service.php chain; added Tagalog keywords.

classes.label: Muscle cramps / spasms
classes.rationale: Hypokalemia presents classically with muscle cramps and spasms; potassium AI is 2000 mg/day for ages 10+ (PDRI 2015).
classes.notes: Deliberate precedence: 'kabag sa kalamnan' (muscle spasm) must be evaluated BEFORE SC-BLOAT's general 'kabag' (digestive gas). Class order in this array implements this.

classes.label: Fatigue / low energy / weakness
classes.rationale: Fatigue and weakness are hallmark presentations of iron-deficiency anemia; iron inadequacy prevalence among Filipino adults is 97-99% (Angeles-Agdeppa et al., 2019, NNS 2013).

classes.label: Dizziness / lightheadedness
classes.rationale: Orthostatic dizziness is associated with low sodium/volume status; PDRI 2015 sets the sodium AI at 500 mg (WHO limit < 2000 mg/day).

classes.label: Headache
classes.rationale: Headache is used as a proxy indicator for calcium/magnesium shortfall in the NutriDeq clinical KB; calcium RNI is 750 mg/day for adults (PDRI 2015).

classes.label: Nausea
classes.rationale: General wellness proxy per NutriDeq clinical KB; vitamin C inadequacy among Filipino adults is 96-98% (NNS 2013).

classes.label: Bloating / gas
classes.rationale: Bloating is the classic presentation of low dietary fiber intake and gut-adjustment to fiber; PDRI 2015 AI is 20-25 g/day for adults.
classes.notes: v1.2.0 keyword fix: 'hininga' (breath) was a v1.1.0 error, corrected to 'hangin' (gas/wind).

classes.label: Unmapped symptom (retained for clinician review only)
classes.rationale: Explicit fallback class so extraction never silently drops symptoms; unmapped entries are stored with NULL mapped_nutrient for dietitian triage instead of forcing a false mapping.
